subject: AWS/GCP/Azure SKU harmonization and channel margin proofing
messages:
From: Tim Lee <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: account_admin@aperturehealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: SKU mapping + surcharge credit question for private offer

Marcus —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Procurement is ready to move but has two asks before we sign the PO: a) confirmation on how list-price surcharges for multi-region deployment will be credited back (we run across APAC and EU in month 1); and b) a clear breakdown that the reseller commission we discussed only applies to the committed net spend (post-credits / true-up). Can you send a short one-pager that shows the math for a sample quarterly true-up?

We need the paperwork for our finance team by COB Monday. I attached our latest SOW for context (see Aperture_SOW_v3.pdf).

—Tim
Tim Lee
Head of Procurement, Aperture Health
procurement@aperturehealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SKU mapping + surcharge credit question for private offer

Hi Tim —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers up front:
- Surcharge/geo tax handling: credits are applied at invoice true-up as a line-item 'Geo Adjustment' that reduces the committed net spend for the quarter.
- Reseller commission: our standard practice is to calculate commission on the net-reconciled spend after credits/true-ups (not on list price).

I'll send a worked example plus a compact SKU harmonization table. Naomi — can you produce the sample quarterly true-up (3 scenarios: conservative / expected / upside) and attach the SKU matrix that maps AWS/GCP/Azure SKUs to our billing classes? Sofia — confirm if the sales-approved commission tranche (8% -> 5% at >$1.2M) needs to be shown explicitly in the doc.

Tim — expect the one-pager in your inbox by Monday morning. If your finance folks want a line-by-line walk-through I'm happy to jump on a 30-min call.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Cloud GTM — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tim Lee <procurement@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:53:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SKU mapping + surcharge credit question for private offer

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 08:53 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus —
>
> Appreciate the clear asks...

Tim / Marcus —

Attached: sku_mapping_matrix.xlsx (compact mapping), draft_private_offer_Aperture.docx (with proposed credit lines). Highlights:
- Example true-up (quarterly) attached, three scenarios with worked math. Summary here:
  * Conservative: committed $120k, geo credits $4.2k, net billed $115.8k, reseller commission @8% = $9.264k
  * Expected: committed $360k, geo credits $16k, net billed $344k, commission ramps to 7% = $24.08k
  * Upside: committed $1.4M, geo credits $65k, net billed $1.335M, commission tranche steps to 5% above $1.2M
- Commission calculation: we apply commissions only to the reconciled net billed amount. Any pre-invoice credits reduce the basis.
- Invoice routing notes: for Marketplace sales we often have two invoice paths — Retail (marketplace invoice) vs. Private Offer (direct invoice). For this deal we recommend Private Offer (direct) routing to avoid marketplace residuals; draft_private_offer_Aperture.docx includes suggested language.

Action items: Marcus will review the wording for the commission tranche; Sofia please confirm if a superficial tax-passback clause is required for APAC shipments. Tim, let me know if any of the line items need to be broken down further for your AP team.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Pricing & Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <procurement@aperturehealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SKU mapping + surcharge credit question for private offer

Tim —

Thanks for raising these. Short confirmation from tax/partner side:
- APAC/EU surcharge credits: we can commit to applying a Geo Adjustment at true-up with a short explanatory line on the invoice (we'll include country-level credit ids so your accounting team can reconcile).
- Reseller commission: endorsement confirmed — commission paid on net-reconciled spend after geo adjustments and true-ups. We'll include a worked example in the final private offer.
- Marketplace vs Private Offer: Private Offer is strongly recommended here to keep invoice routing direct and avoid marketplace fee leakage. If you need us to put the Private Offer into your cloud marketplace procurement system we can coordinate the DocuSign/Marketplace form.

Next steps: Marcus and Naomi will finalize the one-pager and the draft private-offer language. I'll prep the short tax-passback snippet to attach. If Monday is tight, we can extend to Wednesday but understand your finance deadline.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner Finance, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
